verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents manual matching aids: mapping invoices to bank payments, alerts for missing receipts, and automatic booking-category suggestions. It also offers a REST API that developers could build on. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent reconciling a full month, flagging exceptions on its own, or preparing a close for human review. The API is only a building block, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec for agents to use.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: Map invoices directly to your bank payments. See when receipts are missing.
The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk.
